svg.title: How our live auction relays a change
svg.desc: A sequence diagram generated by Archify.

g.text: shortest round trip sets the page clock
only when DO storage woke empty
kept in DO storage for the next join
waitUntil; a lost announce only costs time
no per-card socket from a listing page
at the recorded close; cron is the net
idempotent; the sweep does the same
storage cleared when closed; else re-armed
